page_title: Gladia | AI Audio Infrastructure for Voice Products

summary.name: Gladia
summary.one_liner: Gladia is an AI audio infrastructure API that transcribes and enriches conversations (speech-to-text plus translation) so developers can turn audio into structured data.
keywords: speech to text for voice agents
use_cases: Transcribing media and video content in many languages
Getting translated transcripts in one API call
summary.what_it_does: Gladia offers a single API endpoint for speech-to-text across 100+ languages, with seamless switching when speakers change languages mid-sentence. It keeps sentence structure and timestamps intact during code-switching. Translation (any-to-any) is returned alongside the transcript in the same API call. The page claims robustness on non-native and regional accents and noisy audio. It states latency, pricing, and SLA are the same across supported languages.
notable: Native code-switching within a sentence, keeping timestamps intact
Translation returned in the same API call as the transcript
Covers 100+ languages through one endpoint without per-market models
caveats: Pricing tiers and free-tier limits are not stated on the page
Platform support beyond the API is not described on the page
